training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, trained with pollen-robotics/microduck_rl

training.ball_target_speed_note: set with MICRODUCK_BALL_TARGET_SPEED=0.25 (fork-local env var). Upstream commit 2a0b1b08 restored BALL_TARGET_SPEED=1.0 but kept the 12 / -4 reward weights sized for 0.25 (a3fb8635). config/microduck_ball_kick_env_cfg.py defaults to 1.0; config/env.yaml records the 0.25 the run actually used.
training.robot_model: groundcontact (as upstream); evaluated on the all-collisions robot
training.run_length: stopped at iteration 3650 by a hardware crash; 1000 chosen on eval (later checkpoints lose alignment tolerance, see README)

contract.obs_layout: same as VelStand: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61 (all zero during the kick)
contract.ball_note: the actor is ball-blind: the duck must already stand with the ball at (0.09, -0.042) m in its yaw frame, within about +-15 mm. Only the critic saw the ball.
contract.obs_normalization: empirical normalizer BAKED INTO the ONNX (exported with microduck_rl scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
contract.use: hard swap from VelStand once aligned, run ~2 s, swap back to VelStand (code/kick_mission.py)

measured_results_model_1000.kick_battery_50: kicked 50/50, standing at end 50/50; peak ball speed median 0.375 m/s (1.5x the 0.25 target); travel median 1.28 m; |direction error| median 8.7 deg
measured_results_model_1000.handoff_50: VelStand stand 1.5 s -> kick -> VelStand at 2.0 s: 50/50 kicked and standing; 0.39 m/s, 1.32 m, |dir err| median 13.9 deg
measured_results_model_1000.missions_headless: kick_mission.py 2 x 30 random ball/heading (1.0-1.8 m away): 57/60 kicked, 0 falls (3 aborted: ball bumped while aligning)
measured_results_model_1000.missions_viewer: Dillon's live viewer run, 30 missions: 28 kicked, 0 missed, 2 aborted (ball_lost), 0 falls; ball 0.46 m/s median, 1.26 m, +15 deg off the arrow median (always to the left)

known_weaknesses: SIM ONLY -- never run on the physical robot

kicks land ~15-18 deg left of the intended line, consistently (17.9 deg, std 1.7, from PrecisionStep's +10 mm stance); a property of this policy, compensated since 2026-11-11 by kick_mission.py KICK_AIM_OFFSET = -17.9 deg (+yaw left) -> +0.1 deg median headless, +0.5 deg viewer
ball speed overshoots the 0.25 m/s target ~1.6x
ball-blind: needs the external aligner to place the duck within ~+-15 mm
later checkpoints overfit the start stance: mission success falls from 29/30 at 1000 to 4/30 at 3000
right foot only; no left-foot policy yet
code: github.com/dillonfaulk/microduck_rl, branch local/velstand-own-teachers, commits c1edc0e7 (code) + 0eb1a226 (runs/evals), based on pollen-robotics/microduck_rl
